notes: For the Roon to Spotify crash. The app now asks Android why it died last time and writes it to Downloads/musicd-crash.txt on the next launch, so a crash on a phone stops being unreportable. A run that dies of an Error rather than an exception is recorded as a failed run instead of killing the app silently. And the Spotify token refresh is now shared between the four concurrent workers: an access token lasts an hour, a big library does not, and four simultaneous refreshes with the same single-use rotating token was destroying the sign-in. None of that can happen on a run into Qobuz, whose token neither expires nor rotates.
